title: Control 22 / DP 1956 and Control 24 public digitisation and interconnection release

scope.control_22: Public-safe digest of the 18 June 2026 complaint concerning the Insolvency Administrator, preserving its distinction from the later DP 1956/2026 identity.
scope.control_24: Public-safe digest of the 18 June 2026 judge-related complaint and the 25 June dependent supplement, preserving the absence of a confirmed official court destination or outcome.
scope.querella_interface: States the complainant's use of Control 24 as the documentary basis of a formal querella route while expressly recording that no formal filing receipt has been located.
scope.interconnection: Typed links among Control 21/DP 1901, Control 22/DP 1956, Control 24, Insolvency 36/2012, Fiscalía, CGPJ, removal/fees and the shared documentary modules, without consolidation or transferred liability.

live_verification.representation_rule: The release may be described as merged and deployed. Do not describe the four new routes as independently live-read-back until direct HTTP verification succeeds.

public_boundaries: Control 22 is a filing locator and is not DP 1956/2026.
Control 24 is a filing locator and is not a NIG, preliminary-proceedings number, High Court case or formal querella.
The 25 June contribution is a dependent supplement unless a primary source proves another status.
Prepared, reviewed or sent to counsel does not equal filed.
Related does not equal consolidated and shared evidence does not transfer responsibility.
No allegation is published as an adjudicated finding.
open_gaps: Primary allocation bridge from Control 22 to DP 1956/2026.
Official registry, destination, present location and outcome for Control 24.
Electronic joinder metadata for the 25 June supplement.
Formal querella filing receipt, if any.
Certified Insolvency 36/2012 act-to-knowledge-to-response record for the shared issue modules.
